topics.topic: Whether imported ArtifactPointers represent legacy-made links or links made by the importing owner
questions: Are imported pointers an explicit exception to the claim that every artifact link is made by the agent or owner, or does the owner become the maker/publisher of each link by importing it?
Is every ArtifactPointer a link made by the agent or owner, or may import create a pointer representing a legacy link made by neither?

quotes:
an artifact pointer for a link the agent or the owner makes
(R0-88).

A pointer the import brings in (R0-50) was published before Registry recorded
principals: the v1 Registry keeps no publisher (its `owner_service` is the
caller's own claim, checked by no token) and no withdrawal (L22). Its
publisher is therefore the import itself — the migration closure (M10), not a
principal — and its published and superseded instants are those the source
holds ("Revisions and times").
judgement.why: The categorical agent-or-owner account excludes the imported legacy links that M05 expressly attributes to the migration closure rather than either principal.

topics.topic: Whose claim the digest on an imported ArtifactPointer represents
questions: For an imported pointer, whose claim is the stored digest: the legacy writer or service, the owner performing the import, or the MigrationClosure recorded as publisher?
Whose claim is the digest on an imported pointer: the legacy publisher’s claim transported by import, the owner/import action’s claim, or an un-attributed imported value?

quotes:
its content digest when its publisher gave one (R0-33); all as their writer wrote them
  (R0-68);

Its
publisher is therefore the import itself — the migration closure (M10), not a
principal — and its published and superseded instants are those the source
holds ("Revisions and times").
The digest is its publisher's claim, stored as given (R0-33).
judgement.why: For an imported pointer, M05 defines the import or MigrationClosure as its publisher, so its rule attributes the stored digest claim to that publisher.

topics.topic: Whether an ArtifactPointer asserts current document custody or only records a historical link
questions: Does the pointer assert that the owner service currently holds the document, or only record the link as it was made regardless of the document’s later existence or location?
